subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is-'were'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• ​As the sentence given with blank is in passive form 
 
• And the tense of the sentence is in 'Past' with subject in plural form i.e. (parts of the Amazon rainforest)
 
• Thus, verb should be used in past tense and in plural form as well
 
• Hence, the correct option will be 'were' and therefore the answer 

The correct sentence is: A 2019 study published in the journal Ecohydrology showed that parts of the Amazon rainforest that **were** converted to agricultural land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Let's check each option**:

 
 
• is: used in present tense sentences when the subject is singular.
 
• were: used in past tense sentences when the subject is plural.
 
• ​was: used in past tense sentences when the subject is singular.
 
• has: used in present perfect tense sentences when the subject is singular.​
 
 

45:T
